lobby.title: Live rehearsal
lobby.subtitle: Everyone joins from their own device. The conductor picks the song; each musician sees their own material.
lobby.needsPermission: Only members allowed to conduct can start a session. Ask an admin.

room.noSongBody: Waiting for the conductor to choose a song.
room.noSongConductor: Pick a song from the list to send it to everyone.
room.leaveConfirm: Leave the rehearsal room? The session keeps running for the others.
room.conductorOffline: The conductor is offline. Anyone allowed to conduct can take over.

error.not_conductor: Only the conductor can do that.
error.not_allowed: You are not allowed to do that in this session.
error.unknown_song: That song is not available to this band.

bpmSource.reference: Estimated tempo of the reference recording; the band has not set its own
bpmSource.none: No tempo recorded for this song; set it manually

room.meterUnconfirmed: Time signature not yet confirmed by the band
room.referenceNoLink: The band has not given this recording's link yet.
room.referenceLocal: Plays on this device only, through the platform itself. The rehearsal synchronises tempo and meter, not the audio.

controls.title: Conductor controls

clickModeHelp.synced: Each phone plays its own click following the shared timeline.
clickModeHelp.central: Only one device (connected to the PA or monitors) plays the click. Recommended when acoustic precision is critical.

controls.tempoChangeNote: Tempo changes apply at the next bar.

member.noMaterial: No material for your instrument in this song.
member.noMaterialHint: Ask whoever maintains the repertoire to add one, or pick another material above.

audio.enableBody: Your browser needs a tap before it can play the click. Tap once and keep the screen on during the rehearsal.
audio.blocked: Sound is blocked by the browser. Tap “Enable sound” again.
audio.suspended: Audio was suspended by the system (screen lock or another app). Tap to resume.
audio.unreliable: Timing is unreliable on this device right now. The click may be out of sync.
audio.bluetoothWarning: Bluetooth headphones add noticeable latency. Prefer wired output or the central click mode.

sync.title: Sync quality
sync.help: Measured against the session server. Acoustic simultaneity between devices must still be checked by ear; see the calibration guide in the docs.
